image_description: A white spoonbill standing in shallow, murky green water with a grassy bank in the background. The bird is facing left, displaying its characteristic long, flat, spatulate bill. Its plumage is predominantly white with a slight yellowish tint on the breast and a visible crest of elongated feathers on the nape. One dark leg is clearly visible standing in the water, while the other is obscured or merged with the reflection. The eye is pale/yellowish with a dark pupil.

The water texture is somewhat uniform and painterly. The reflection of the bird's body is faint and indistinct, lacking the complex distortion patterns usually seen in real water surfaces. It looks more like a green overlay than a physical reflection.

The second leg is completely missing or fully occluded. In a natural standing pose, even if hidden behind the first leg, some indication of the second leg or foot placement is often visible. Its total absence suggests a minor structural simplification common in AI generation.
